{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "id": "starter",
  "name": "Starter",
  "version": "1.0.0",

  "description": "Default starter theme with responsive layout and common marketing sections.",
  "requires": "1",
  "settings": [
    {
      "key": "primaryColor",
      "type": "color",
      "label": "Primary color",
      "required": false,
      "translatable": false,
      "default": "#0b3d5c"
    },
    {
      "key": "fontFamily",
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Font family",
      "required": false,
      "translatable": false,
      "default": "Georgia, \"Times New Roman\", serif"
    },
    {
      "key": "logo",
      "type": "media",
      "label": "Logo",
      "required": false,
      "translatable": false
    },
    {
      "key": "footerText",
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Footer text",
      "required": false,
      "translatable": true,
      "default": ""
    }
  ],
  "menus": [
    { "id": "primary", "name": "Primary" },
    { "id": "footer", "name": "Footer" }
  ],
  "templates": [
    { "id": "full-width", "name": "Full width" },
    { "id": "no-chrome", "name": "No chrome" }
  ],
  "styles": ["assets/style.css"]
}
